data.name: Marker_NotHeader
data.value: Not part of the header, so without effect: header lines stand at the very top, before any other comment or SQL and without a blank line between them.
data.comment: Mark on a -- @param/@target/@description line below the header

data.name: Target_TableMissing
data.value: This connection has no table or view {0}: the script shows in no cell menu here.

data.name: Target_ColumnMissing
data.value: {0} has no column {1}: the script shows in no cell menu here.

data.name: Hover_NotHeader
data.value: **Not part of the header** – without effect. Header lines stand at the very top of the text, before any other comment or SQL and without a blank line between them.
data.comment: Markdown, hover in the SQL editor; keep ** as is

data.name: Hover_Description
data.value: **@description** *text* – the script’s description, shown in the tooltip of the script in the explorer. Several lines make several paragraphs. Saving takes it into the save dialog; the line then leaves the text.
data.comment: Markdown, hover over a -- @description line; keep ** and * as is

data.name: Hover_Param
data.value: **@param** *name type* [`list`] – the type a bind of the SQL is bound as: {0}. With `list` the bind stands alone in `IN ( … )` and takes the values of several marked rows. Saving takes the type into the variables; the line then leaves the text. Never a value.
data.comment: Markdown, hover over a -- @param line; {0}: the type names, comma separated

data.name: Hover_Target
data.value: **@target** *name TABLE.COLUMN* – the column the parameter takes its value from: the script shows in the cell menu of this column and of every column that refers to it. Write the table without owner; the parameter needs a bind in the SQL.
data.comment: Markdown, hover over a -- @target line

data.name: Hover_Unknown
data.value: FerretSharp does not know {0}: the line is kept as it is (a newer version’s or a colleague’s line), without effect.
data.comment: Markdown, hover over an unknown header line; {0}: the directive as code

data.name: Hover_UnknownSimilar
data.value: FerretSharp does not know {0} – did you mean {1}? The line is kept as it is, without effect.
data.comment: Markdown, hover over a header line with a typo; {0}: as typed; {1}: the known directive

data.name: Hover_More
data.value: More on scripts: *Help* in the SQL tab’s toolbar.
data.comment: Markdown, last line of the hover over a header line; Help is the button label
